Connecting conveyor belts

Factory machines →

Paint tiles to build a run. The pieces connect automatically.

Click or drag across the tile grid to paint. Right-click to erase. Ends, bends and junctions update together. Branches use ball-transfer tables; flow direction and item transport are not simulated.

Reusable one-tile models and neighbour rules. Interactive art study; map-editor placement and production routing are not integrated.
